statistics_rule: Residential focal parcels and residential border neighbors only for both cohorts; all commercial properties and hotels excluded.

neighbor_only_comparison.rule: Residential direct border neighbors only; focal parcel calls excluded; all commercial and hotel calls excluded.

listing_screen.source_policy: Local listing title, description, amenities and house-rules section only; raw source files unchanged. No reviews or host biography used.
listing_screen.row_grain: One listing row per folder; parcel call totals can repeat across listings. Feature statistics deduplicate parcel PINs.

comparison_display.control_rule: Original fixed random nonlicensed residential sample; selected initiation measure (citizen-initiated by default); selected call categories apply; unaffected by listing filters.
comparison_display.table_denominator: House: focal parcels; house + neighbors: focal parcels plus neighbor memberships; neighbors only: neighbor memberships. All residential: full-population direct rate. All denominators multiply exposure years.
comparison_display.map_rule: Exclude every ineligible licensed parcel and hotel from map rendering and search.

occupancy_scenario.definition: Booked nights divided by available nights, averaged over active listings.
occupancy_scenario.assumptions: Year-round availability; citywide snapshot applied across study period; not property-specific observed occupancy or event attribution.
